[[Magmus' Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] obtained from the [[Mountain Heart Chest]], which spawns after killing [[Cyndr the Mountain Heart]] or [[Magmus]] in [[Heart of the Shiverpeaks]]. 

== Stats ==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Chaos damage]] 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Energy Storage]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +30

== Skin ==
The skin is a different colored version of another unique staff, [[Earthbound Staff]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Energy Storage]] [[staves]]:
**[[Ether Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
**[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Elemental Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Staff]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Staff of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Charr Staff]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Staff]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Staff]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Staff]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Insightful]] [[Staff Head]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Don't Think Twice]]" inscription

==Unique counterpart==
[[Milius' Pillar]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Earth damage]] and requires [[Earth Magic]].
